int findBinaryExponentian(int a, int pow, int mod) {
    if (pow == 1) {
        return a % mod;
    } else if (pow == 0) {
        return 1;
    } else {
        int retVal = findBinaryExponentian(a, pow / 2, mod);
        int val = (pow % 2 == 0) ? 1 : a;

int bleft(int ele, vector<int>& sortedArr) {
    int l = 0;
    int h = sortedArr.size() - 1;
    int ans = -1;
    while (l <= h) {
        int mid = l + (h - l) / 2;
        if (sortedArr[mid] < ele) {
            ans = mid;
            l = mid + 1;
        } else {
            h = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

int gcd(int a, int b) {
    int div = b;
    int rem = a % b;
    while (rem != 0) {
        int temp = rem;
        rem = div % rem;
        div = temp;
    }
    return div;
}

unordered_set<int> primeList(int MAXI) {
    vector<int> prime(MAXI + 1, 0);
    unordered_set<int> obj;
    for (int i = 2; i <= (int)sqrt(MAXI) + 1; i++) {
        if (prime[i] == 0) {
            obj.insert(i);
            for (int j = i * i; j <= MAXI; j += i) {
                prime[j] = 1;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = (int)sqrt(MAXI) + 1; i <= MAXI; i++) {
        if (prime[i] == 0) {
            obj.insert(i);
        }
    }
    return obj;
}

vector<int> factorialList(int MAXI, int mod) {

    for (int i = 3; i <= MAXI; i++) {

int optimSearch(vector<int>& cnt, int lower_bound, int pow, int n) {
    int l = lower_bound + 1;
    int h = n;
    int ans = 0;
    while (l <= h) {
        int mid = l + (h - l) / 2;
        if (cnt[mid] - cnt[lower_bound] == pow) {

Pair<long long, int> ret_ans(vector<int>& ans) {
    int size = ans.size();
    int mini = 1000000001;
    long long tit = 0LL;
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        tit += ans[i];
        mini = min(mini, ans[i]);
    }
    return Pair<long long, int>(tit - mini, mini);
}

int factorList(
    unordered_map<int, int>& maps,
    int no,
    int maxK,
    int req
) {
    int i = 1;
    while (i * i <= no) {
        if (no % i == 0) {
            if (i != no / i) {
                put(maps, no / i);
            }
            put(maps, i);
            if (maps[i] == req) {
                maxK = max(maxK, i);
            }
            if (maps[no / i] == req) {
                maxK = max(maxK, no / i);
            }
        }
        i++;
    }
    return maxK;
}
